cover_letter:
Dear Cebir Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Digital Testbuilder (Junior/Medior) position advertised at Cebir. Having followed Cebir’s commitment to scientifically validated assessment solutions, I am particularly drawn to a role that combines robust psychometric science with modern technology, and I believe my technical skills and dedication to user experience align well with your team’s objectives.

My background includes hands-on experience in front-end development, specifically with JavaScript (AngularJS) and a strong command of HTML and CSS. In my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I regularly build and maintain client websites using WordPress, which involves crafting responsive designs and managing content uploads. This work requires meticulous attention to detail to ensure seamless functionality and a clear user interface – skills directly applicable to building and adapting interactive online tests within your platform. My personal project, mirook.com, further showcases my ability to implement structured data and entity markup, ensuring content is not only visible but also accurately represented and easy to interpret for users.

I understand the importance of delivering a smooth, reliable, and user-friendly candidate experience, which resonates strongly with my focus on technical accuracy and interface consistency in web development. I thrive in environments where I can take ownership of my work and contribute directly to product evolution. My experience running iterative technical SEO/GEO audits demonstrates a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues, ensuring optimal performance and functionality.

I am excited by the prospect of contributing to Cebir’s mission and growing within a small, impactful team. Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can benefit Cebir.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
